free_text: The patient is a 58-year-old male with a high PSA of 9.1 ng/mL and a PI-RADS 4 lesion on MRI. Biopsies confirm low-grade adenocarcinoma (Gleason 3+3, ISUP Grade Group 1). The management assessment is active surveillance due to the low-grade nature of the disease. The trade-off involves balancing the risk of progression against the potential morbidity associated with active treatment for indolent cancer.
